column1: # Slovak (sk) catalog. Added by FreeANDIY (Free Andy Agency), 2026; MIT OR Apache-2.0 like the
# other catalogs. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other"; the translation lists the Slovak forms
#                                 "one|few|other" (1 | 2–4 | 0, 5+), see `plural_czech` in i18n/mod.rs
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Slovak computing vocabulary (vrstva, výber, štetec, cesta, kotviaci bod, výkres, krytie ...). No
# proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; in
# particular not the Slovak localisation of any commercial vector editor. Add entries the same way.
# Conventions: menus are nouns (Súbor, Úpravy, Objekt ...), commands are infinitives or nouns
# (Otvoriť…, Uložiť ako…), sentence case as in the English source. Product and technology names
# ({{this.name}}, OpenType, CMYK, Lab ...) stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog
# commands is kept.
# Coverage: the menu bar (menus, submenus and their items) and the common strings shared with
# the other FreeANDIY apps. Everything else falls back to English until translated.
